Evidence: Imran Khan ne baar baar kaha hai ke wo apne logon aur mulk ke liye kisi bhi qurbani dene ko tayyar hain. Unka 'azm' yaani unki bepanah himmat is baat ka saboot hai (Source 1). Unhone yeh bhi kaha hai ke asal azaadi ke liye qurbani deni padegi (Source 3). Lekin, evidence mein kisi bhi tarah se unki corruption ya beghairati ka zikar nahi hai, sirf unki qurbani aur azm ka zikr hai.
Justification: Retrieved evidence sirf Imran Khan ki qurbani aur unki himmat ko darshata hai, lekin ismein unki corruption ya beghairati ka koi saboot nahi hai. Isliye, claim jo unhe ghatia shaks aur corrupt kehlata hai, uska koi sahara nahi milta. Evidence ke mutabiq, unki qurbaniyon ko appreciate karne ki zarurat hai, jo claim ke core assertion ko refute karta hai.
